listing.name: Theme Hospital / Theme Hospital Enhanced
listing.summary: Explore Theme Hospital / Theme Hospital Enhanced and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Use the appropriate runtime
steps.instruction: This reconstructs the DOS Theme Hospital executable. Its hospital.exe/hosp.exe outputs use DOS/4GW and DOSBox; they are not native Windows players to register directly. Before following the source build, establish the needed input and toolchain/component permissions: the guide names its accepted GOG offline installer/HOSPITAL.EXE, its first Nix shell downloads proprietary Watcom 10.5/10.6 CDs, and tools GPL does not grant rights to reconstructed, Miles, Smacker or Watcom code. An owned GOG copy alone does not settle every component. The conditional DOS build/run guide remains upstream; Portcove invokes no installer or toolchain. For a distinct managed native alternative, find CorsixTH in Discover.

references.title: Follow the current DOS build
references.instruction: The pinned master revision documents the DOS reconstruction. Use the matching owned GOG installer identified by upstream. After closing DOSBox, preserve build/run, including HOSPITAL.CFG and your saves, and keep the original data it links from orig. The earlier native branch instructions apply to a different revision.

decisions.rationale: The owner matteo-pacini renamed the repository it listed; the same repository answers at matteo-pacini/theme-hospital-decomp. Keep the Portcove identity and listing; only its project location changes.

evidence.note: The commit this listing's setup guide pins is present in the current repository, authored by matteo-pacini.
The listed path resolves to matteo-pacini/theme-hospital-decomp, repository ID 1401277649.

decisions.reconsider_when: A different repository ID at the current location, a conflicting maintainer statement or a repository history discrepancy requires a new lineage decision.
